summary: Frontend-only pass at 1366x768. Verified #2 (test plan removal), #4 (collapsed sidebar switcher solid bg), #5 (Settings removed from main sidebar, only in profile menu), and ran #6 responsiveness audit across authenticated pages. All three targeted fixes (#2/#4/#5) are correctly implemented. Responsiveness audit surfaced a few real overflow issues, most notably on /plan where the primary CTA sits below the 768 fold.

ui_bugs.issue: Page content overflows vertically at 1366x768 (documentElement.scrollHeight = 830, viewport = 768). The primary 'Pay with UPI / Card' button (data-testid=plan-continue) sits at the very bottom and is clipped/below the fold. Needs page-level scroll or tighter vertical spacing so the CTA is visible without scrolling.
Last 'Recent' row in Overview panel extends past viewport (top=762, bottom=805) - approx 37px clipped below the 768 fold. Row is not scrollable into view (page docSH stays 768).

help-faq UL bottom = 775 (7px below viewport). Last .help-faq-item bottom=775 is slightly clipped. Container .ov-panel bottom=790. Only ~7-22px clipped so minor, but content is not scrollable at page level (docSH=768).

notes-list UL extends to bottom=894 (126px below viewport). Notes further down the list (e.g. notes-item-3894db51-...) are only partially visible. Behaves as internally scrollable panel (page docSH stays 768) so likely intended, but user experiences an item straddling the fold with only ~20px visible - consider tightening list max-height or increasing internal padding so partial rows aren't half-shown.

issues: Primary CTA below fold - user must scroll to see 'Pay with UPI / Card'

#2_test_plan_removed./plan: PASS - [data-testid=plan-test-activate] absent, [data-testid=plan-continue] present, no '₹0' or 'Activate free' text, ₹999 and ₹199 plans still visible.
#2_test_plan_removed./admin: PASS - [data-testid=admin-test-plan-toggle] absent, Product Hunt toggle still present (visible 'Product Hunt offer ON' in header).
#2_test_plan_removed.PlanModal_from_switcher: N/A - Clicking 'New project' from psb-switcher opened onboarding/welcome dialog (project quota not reached for this account). No '₹0' / 'Test · free' text encountered in that flow.

#4_collapsed_switcher_solid.result: PASS - Collapsed psb-switcher retains solid dark background and visible border; no transparency.

#5_settings_only_in_profile_menu.Clicking Settings navigates to Settings/: PASS - Account page rendered with Profile/Password sections

action_items: Fix /plan vertical overflow at 1366x768 so [data-testid=plan-continue] is above the fold (tighten spacing on the Product Hunt promo card + plan cards, or reduce top padding).
Fix /app dashboard: last home-recent row extends ~37px below the 768 fold; either reduce grid heights, allow the recents list to scroll internally, or drop one row.
Minor: Help page .help-faq slightly clipped (~7px) at 1366x768 - consider internal scroll on .ov-panel or shrinking padding.
Optional: Meeting Notes list shows a half-visible row at the fold; adjust max-height to snap to full-row heights.
critical_code_review_comments: The .project-sidebar.is-collapsed .psb-switch styling is now correct (solid bg + border + hover). Good.
ProjectSidebar footer nav no longer renders Settings item; Settings is only inside psb-user-menu - matches requirement.
PlanModal / ChoosePlan / AdminDashboard no longer expose the free-test plan option in any surface I could reach.
Fixed 100dvh shell holds - no horizontal overflow anywhere I visited (dashboard, project home, conversations, notes, timeline, help, settings, /admin, /plan). Only /plan reports docSH > 768.

success_rate.frontend: Fixes #2/#4/#5: 100% pass. Responsiveness #6: 4 overflow issues found (1 HIGH, 1 MEDIUM, 2 LOW).

rca of the issue: Not a bug regression - #2/#4/#5 all correctly landed. The /plan vertical overflow appears to stem from the Product Hunt promo card (Try free 14 days) being added above the plan cards which pushed the CTA below 768; the page has no scroll-friendly container so the button is clipped at fixed 100dvh viewport.
